GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 7th 6 Lengths 600m 7th 8 Lengths Straightened Up 8th rail Checked 100m Kept Going Ok Straight # chk/held pos/ok

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Rolled fwd before raced 4th on inside (2.5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & back 1/2L @ 550m. Pushed to quicken @ 450m & Two Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Four Wide in last 200m. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. got split 200 metres. ran on strongly # very good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping away. Raced keenly when being restrained in the early stages and near the 800m was steadied when awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward to lead.5 Lengths 600m .5 Lengths lead home turn 1st 2 Lengths kicked 200m Kept Going Too Well in a blanket finish # led/held on
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 8th 3 Wide 600m 7th 3 Wide 8 Lengths Straightened Up 7th Under Pressure weakened badly final 250m # very weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Left racing wide and without cover from the 900m. M. Cahill reported that although his mnt endured a wide run he was still disappointed with the mare’s finishing effort in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination did not reveal any abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped well 800m 4th 3wide 3len 600m 3rd 2len Straightened Up 4th Wide Kept Going Ok # wide/fair effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Got its head up and raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Not early speed & raced @ rear Two Wide (out of picture). Stayed out of picture until chasing Four Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Laid out & gave ground in straight. # Always struggling.
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 10 lengths. last turn. made some ground # start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Had to be be steadied when racing keenly near the 600m

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Four Wide No Cover (5L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & chasing Seven Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Seven Wide in straight. # Wide/never likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Required to race very wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on one pace # back/no threat
Jumped Ok drifted back 4-5l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 4l off, ducked back towards rail and ran on strong taking lead 50m and drew clear late # back/ran on strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When qst re improved performance, rdr std mnt failed to run out 1100m in first start & better suited with the drop back in distance which was run at a better tempo. Add addition of earmuffs to gear attributed to improved performance. When also qst re improved performance, Tnr std stable disappointed with first start & attributed that to the mare being worked up in the prelim & fractious in the barriers. Add mare worked well in the lead up & stable vet exam found no abs. Agreed with rider in respect to the addition of earmuffs. Stewards noted the explanations.
